title: fix(service-automation)!: a map whose item run was cancelled records the item as cancelled on a parent-id resume
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DG3gN5hhvu8HEmLydwk8EsW)_
Fixes #27971

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Ruling-ref: 6523833308
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` names neither `RESUME_CHILD_PENDING` nor a map's cancelled item, so no skill text describes the shape that changes; the hand-written guide `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (batch-approval paragraph) is updated here, and the generated `content/docs/references/automation/builtin-node-config.mdx` is regenerated from the spec describe.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:批量节点(map)里某一项的子流程被取消后，再用 map 自己的 run id 恢复，map 会继续往下走，并在该项的位置记下 `{ $status: 'cancelled', $itemRunId }` 标记；`count` 只算真正跑过的项。子项挂起记录没了、运行历史又不是 cancelled 的，直接 409 拒绝，什么都不动。
- 为什么改:以前取消一项后恢复批次，map 会悄悄跳过这一项，results 少一项、下标错位，批次还显示 completed。按你的裁决 A 修。
- 风险与回滚:只影响停在内置 map 节点、且子项挂起记录已不在的那次恢复；正常完成的项、仍挂起的项(409)不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts`(continuePastCancelledMapItem 的判定与拒绝)、`src/builtin/map-node.ts`(标记写入与 count)、`src/map-cancelled-item-resume.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/map-cancelled-item-resume.test.ts`，预期 7 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无，席位在 fable 契约复审通过后落地。

## What changes

- **The resume gate reads the item's run history** (`run-resume.ts`, `continuePastCancelledMapItem`). When a run's linked-run chain ends on a `map:` link whose item suspension row is gone, and the run is parked at the built-in `map` node, the gate calls `getRun(itemRunId)`:
  - status `cancelled` (written by `cancelRun`, which never touches the parent): `resume` continues with an engine-built signal that sets the handoff variable `MAPNODE.$mapItemCancelled` to the item run id;
  - anything else — no history row, an unreadable store (`getRun` degrades to `null`), a status other than `cancelled`: refused `409 RESUME_CHILD_PENDING` (#27877's code) before any state is touched, with a message saying the item is no longer suspended and what its history says.
- **The map records the marker** (`builtin/map-node.ts`). On re-entry with that handoff it pushes `{ $status: 'cancelled', $itemRunId }` into the item's slot, so `results[i]` is still item `i`. `count` is the items that ran (`isMapItemCancelledMarker` filters the markers); the cancelled item adds nothing to the step totals. The marker is closed and `$`-keyed: a child flow's output keys are its declared variable names, which `flowBoundVariableNameSchema` keeps off `$`, so no real output can look like it.
- **Through a `subflow` link too.** The engine-built signal is delegated down to the map one level below, the same way a caller's signal is.
- **The caller still cannot write the handoff.** A caller signal that writes the engine's `$` namespace gets no continuation; `resumeInternal` refuses it `400 INVALID_SIGNAL` with the run left parked, as before.
- **Only the built-in `map` node.** Another executor that mints a `map:` correlation keeps its resume unchanged (the concurrent-replica test's `map_items` node is one).
- **Spec and docs.** `MapConfigSchema.outputVariable`'s describe and the map node's own config-schema description say an element can be the marker; `flows.mdx`'s batch paragraph describes the marker, `count`, and both 409 arms; the reference page is regenerated.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/service-automation` minor, `@objectstack/spec` minor (`Metadata-protocol: added`), with `Ruling-ref: 6523833308` and the ADR-0087 answer `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

New `src/map-cancelled-item-resume.test.ts` (7 cases): the cancelled item's slot holds the marker, the map parks on item 2, and the downstream node reads `[marker, {done: 'ran t2'}]` with `count` 1; the same one level down through a `subflow` parent; an item row gone without a `cancelled` history row is refused 409 with nothing moved; an unreadable history is refused 409; a caller signal writing `$mapItemCancelled` is refused `INVALID_SIGNAL`; controls: a still-suspended item is still refused naming it, and items that complete are recorded as before with `count` 2.

<details><summary>Ablations (fix committed first; the tests import ./engine.js and ./builtin/map-node.js from src, no dist on the path)</summary>

Each via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor x1 → x0 on disk, then the run, then restore to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):

- status check `item?.status !== 'cancelled'` → `item == null`: *refuses … without a cancelled history row* red (1 failed, 6 passed).
- the caller-signal guard (`applyResumeSignal(new Map(), signal, link.nodeId)` line) deleted: *still refuses a caller signal that writes the engine namespace* red (1 failed, 6 passed).
- `count` filter → `state.results.length`: the two marker cases red (2 failed, 5 passed).
- the marker push deleted: the two marker cases red (2 failed, 5 passed).
- the `nodeType !== 'map'` guard deleted: `concurrent-replica-resume-race.test.ts` *THE CONDITION (correlation)* red (1 failed, 11 passed). That pin is how the guard was found: without it the gate refused that test's synthetic `map:item_1` correlation.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Measured on `main` f6adf480 before the fix: `cancelRun(item1)` answered `true` and `getRun(item1).status` read `cancelled`; `resume(parentId)` answered `success`/`paused`, `$mapState` became `{started: 2, results: []}`, and after item 2 completed the parent was `completed` with a downstream node reading `results` = [item 2's output] and `count` 1.
- The marker's keys (`$status`, `$itemRunId`) are the dev's proposal under ruling A; the ruling leaves their exact spelling to the contract review.
- The approval revise-window recall (`plugin-approvals` calling `cancelRun`) is a producer of a cancelled item in a batch sign-off; read, not measured here.
